notes: severity is the severity when the construct is rejected; a construct handled by an emulation is reported with emulatedSeverity at its tier

rules.title: animation refers to a missing @keyframes
rules.why: The animation name has no @keyframes rule.
rules.fix: Define the keyframes or fix the name.

rules.title: Unsupported animated property
rules.why: The property is not animatable in USS (or not a USS property).
rules.fix: Animate opacity, colours, translate, scale or rotate.

rules.title: Layout property animated
rules.why: Animating layout properties recalculates the layout each frame.
rules.fix: Animate translate or scale instead.

rules.title: Too many keyframe steps
rules.why: Long step chains are costly and hard to maintain.
rules.fix: Reduce the number of steps.

rules.title: No reduced-motion handling
rules.why: Looping or large motion should be skippable for players who disable motion.
rules.fix: Add data-reduced-motion="skip" or "simplify".

rules.title: Invalid animation timing or iteration
rules.why: Duration, delay or iteration-count cannot be represented.
rules.fix: Use positive seconds or milliseconds and an integer or infinite.

rules.title: display: grid / inline-grid
rules.why: UI Toolkit implements a subset of flexbox (Yoga); there is no grid layout.
rules.fix: Use nested flex rows and columns: flex-direction: row for a row, a column container per column.

rules.title: gap / row-gap / column-gap
rules.why: USS of Unity 6000.6 has no gap, row-gap or column-gap (not in the property reference nor in the UIElements module).
rules.fix: Use margins on the children, for example margin-right on every item but the last, or margin-top between rows.

rules.title: :not() / :is() / :where() / :has()
rules.why: USS selectors support only type, #name, .class, *, descendant, child and a fixed list of pseudo-classes.
rules.fix: Toggle an explicit class from code (for example .is-active) and style that class.

rules.title: Structural pseudo-class
rules.why: :nth-child(), :first-child, :last-child, :only-child, :empty and similar are not supported by USS.
rules.fix: Add an explicit class to the element (for example .first, .last) and select it.

rules.title: Pseudo-element
rules.why: ::before, ::after, ::placeholder and other pseudo-elements do not exist in UI Toolkit.
rules.fix: Add a real child element (a div or span) and style it.

rules.title: calc() / min() / max() / clamp() / env() / attr()
rules.why: USS values are literals, var() references or colour/url functions; there are no math functions.
rules.fix: Use fixed values, percentages, flex-grow/flex-basis or nested containers.

rules.title: Unsupported at-rule
rules.why: @media, @supports, @container, @layer, @keyframes, @font-face, @import and @page are not generated by this converter.
rules.fix: Express responsive rules with classes toggled from code (for example .ui--phone), and animations with transitions or the animation spec.

rules.title: Unsupported unit
rules.why: USS lengths are px and %, angles deg, times s and ms; vh, vw, vmin, vmax, em, rem, pt, ch and fr do not exist.
rules.fix: Use px, %, or flex sizing.

rules.title: Unsupported position value
rules.why: USS supports position: relative (default) and absolute only.
rules.fix: Use relative or absolute; for sticky or fixed bars use an absolute child of the panel root.

rules.title: filter / backdrop-filter
rules.why: Filters exist in Unity 6000.6 USS but only a fixed set of functions, they cost fill rate on mobile and the browser preview is not a faithful reference.
rules.fix: Check the result in Unity; prefer a pre-baked image or an overlay element.

rules.title: Gradient
rules.why: USS has no gradient background; the project rules also forbid them.
rules.fix: Use a pre-rendered image (background-image: url()) or a solid colour.

rules.title: background shorthand or multiple backgrounds
rules.why: USS has background-color, background-image (one image), background-position, background-size and background-repeat longhands only.
rules.fix: Split into the longhands; use child elements for extra layers.

rules.title: box-shadow
rules.why: USS has no box-shadow (only text-shadow).
rules.fix: Add a sibling or child element with a darker, offset background, or use a border.

rules.title: Property is not a USS property
rules.why: The property does not exist in the Unity 6000.6 USS property reference, so the importer ignores it.
rules.fix: See the suggested replacement.

rules.title: Unsupported selector syntax
rules.why: Sibling combinators (+, ~), attribute selectors and the >>> combinator are not supported by USS.
rules.fix: Use classes and the descendant (space) or child (>) combinator.

rules.title: Type selector
rules.why: HTML tag selectors do not map to UI Toolkit element types; a div is not a VisualElement selector and element types match exactly.
rules.fix: Select by class (.name) or name (#name).

rules.title: !important
rules.why: USS has no !important; precedence follows specificity and order.
rules.fix: Raise specificity with a more specific selector instead.

rules.title: CSS-wide keyword
rules.why: Only initial is supported in USS; inherit, unset and revert are not.
rules.fix: Write the explicit value, or use initial.

rules.title: Unsupported display value
rules.why: USS display is flex (default) or none.
rules.fix: Use display: flex; every element is already a flex container (column by default).

rules.title: Unsupported overflow value
rules.why: USS overflow is visible or hidden; there is no auto, scroll, overflow-x or overflow-y.
rules.fix: Use a ScrollView (data-uxml="ScrollView") for scrolling content.

rules.title: z-index
rules.why: UI Toolkit draws siblings in document order; there is no z-index.
rules.fix: Reorder the elements so later siblings draw on top, or use position: absolute children placed last.

rules.title: Unsupported transform
rules.why: USS has separate rotate, scale and translate properties and no transform shorthand with several functions.
rules.fix: Use rotate: 45deg, scale: 1.1 or translate: 10px 0, one function per property.

rules.title: Invalid or unsupported value
rules.why: The value is not valid for this USS property.
rules.fix: Use a value from the USS property reference.

rules.title: Unsupported border style
rules.why: USS borders are always solid; there is no dashed, dotted or double border and no border-style property.
rules.fix: Use solid borders or an image.

rules.title: box-sizing other than border-box
rules.why: UI Toolkit always uses border-box.
rules.fix: Remove box-sizing or use border-box and adjust the size.

rules.title: Several text shadows
rules.why: USS text-shadow takes exactly one shadow.
rules.fix: Keep one shadow, or duplicate the label.

rules.title: Nested CSS rule
rules.why: The converter reads flat rules only.
rules.fix: Flatten the nesting into separate selectors.

rules.title: CSS syntax error
rules.why: The stylesheet cannot be parsed reliably; the declaration or block is dropped.
rules.fix: Fix the syntax (missing colon, semicolon or brace).

rules.title: text-overflow: ellipsis without clipping
rules.why: Ellipsis only applies when overflow is hidden and white-space is nowrap.
rules.fix: Add overflow: hidden and white-space: nowrap.

rules.title: font-family without a font asset mapping
rules.why: USS fonts are font assets (-unity-font-definition); the family name has no meaning in Unity.
rules.fix: Map the family in the config (fonts) or set -unity-font-definition in the page CSS.

rules.title: var() reference to an undefined custom property
rules.why: An undefined var() makes UI Toolkit ignore the whole declaration.
rules.fix: Define the variable in :root (page CSS or a referenced skin) or write the literal value.

rules.title: Token redefines a skin token with a different value
rules.why: The page tokens file is loaded after the skin, so the new value replaces the skin value for the whole screen.
rules.fix: Rename the token or align the value.

rules.title: Unsupported pseudo-class
rules.why: USS supports :hover, :active, :inactive, :focus, :disabled, :enabled, :checked and :root.
rules.fix: Use one of the supported pseudo-classes or toggle a class from code.

rules.title: HTML element without a UI Toolkit counterpart
rules.why: UXML only contains VisualElement-derived controls; HTML-only elements such as tables, lists, headings or inline emphasis cannot be represented.
rules.fix: Use div, span, label, button, input, select, img, progress or data-uxml="<Element>".

rules.title: Unsupported input type
rules.why: UI Toolkit has no native control for this input type.
rules.fix: Use type=text, range, checkbox, radio, number, or map the element explicitly with data-uxml.

rules.title: Unknown data-uxml value
rules.why: data-uxml must name a known UI Toolkit element of the dialect.
rules.fix: Pick one of the documented data-uxml names (see README).

rules.title: Attribute is ignored by the conversion
rules.why: The attribute has no UXML equivalent and is dropped.
rules.fix: Remove it or move the behaviour to code.

rules.title: Event handler or link attribute
rules.why: UXML cannot carry inline scripts or hyperlinks.
rules.fix: Remove it; bind behaviour in C# by element name (and data-nav in the page flow).

rules.title: Text inside an element that cannot hold text
rules.why: Only Label, Button (and controls with a label) show text; a VisualElement has no text property.
rules.fix: Wrap the text in <span data-loc="key">.

rules.title: Label with child elements
rules.why: A UI Toolkit Label is a text element and cannot contain children.
rules.fix: Make the container a div and put the Label (span) and the other elements inside it.

rules.title: Button with child elements
rules.why: A Button may contain children but they are drawn on top of its text and are not clipped by it.
rules.fix: Prefer a div container with a button and sibling elements, or keep the button text-only.

rules.title: Script not allowed in a convertible page
rules.why: UXML has no scripting; scripts in the mock are only allowed for the mock harness (uitk-validate.js, uitk-prototype.js).
rules.fix: Remove the script, or mark the harness include with data-uitk-harness.

rules.title: Stylesheet link that is not a local CSS file
rules.why: Local .css files are job inputs and data-uss declares an existing USS; remote URLs and other link types cannot be converted.
rules.fix: Link a local .css file, declare a skin with data-uss="<src as written in UXML>", or inline the CSS in a <style> block.

rules.title: Inline style attribute
rules.why: Inline styles end up as inline UXML styles, which the style rules of the project forbid and which cannot use selectors, states or variables.
rules.fix: Move the declarations into a class in the <style> block.

rules.title: Image source cannot be resolved inside the project
rules.why: UI Toolkit loads images from project assets, not from arbitrary paths or URLs.
rules.fix: Reference a file inside the project (src relative to the HTML file) or use a USS background-image.

rules.title: Missing element for the selected dialect feature
rules.why: The element needs an attribute that the converter requires (for example a name for an img).
rules.fix: Add the missing attribute.

rules.title: Invalid UXML attribute value
rules.why: The value cannot be represented as a UXML attribute.
rules.fix: Use a plain number or keyword.

rules.title: Skin stylesheet file not found
rules.why: The class inventory of the skin cannot be checked, so classes it defines look undefined.
rules.fix: Fix the data-uss path (it is the src written into <Style src> relative to the UXML folder) or the config layout.

rules.title: Unsupported named character reference
rules.why: Only numeric references and the predefined amp, lt, gt, quot, apos and nbsp are decoded; other named references are not part of the dialect.
rules.fix: Write the character itself or a numeric reference such as →.

rules.title: Emulation could not be applied
rules.why: The construct is emulated at conversion time but this input is outside what the emulation can resolve.
rules.fix: See the message for the unsupported part and the suggested rewrite.

rules.title: End tag without a matching start tag
rules.why: The HTML parser had to guess how to recover; browsers and the converter may disagree.
rules.fix: Remove the end tag or add the missing start tag.

rules.title: Element not closed
rules.why: The HTML parser had to guess how to recover; browsers and the converter may disagree.
rules.fix: Close the element explicitly.

rules.title: Unterminated comment, tag, attribute or raw text
rules.why: The HTML parser had to guess how to recover; browsers and the converter may disagree.
rules.fix: Close the construct at the reported position.

rules.title: Self-closing syntax on a non-void element
rules.why: The parser ignores the self-closing slash on non-void elements, as browsers do.
rules.fix: Write the element with an explicit end tag.

rules.title: Elements nested deeper than 512
rules.why: The parser refuses to nest deeper than 512 to bound stack use.
rules.fix: Flatten the markup.

rules.title: Selector defined in several sheets with different values
rules.why: The later sheet wins by cascade order; the two definitions are probably unintended.
rules.fix: Remove one definition or give the rules different selectors.

rules.title: Missing stylesheet, import or skin file
rules.why: The input set refers to a file that does not exist.
rules.fix: Fix the path or add the file.

rules.title: Circular @import
rules.why: A stylesheet imports itself directly or through other sheets.
rules.fix: Break the cycle.

rules.title: Duplicate element name across pages of one document
rules.why: Names are used by code lookups; pages assembled into one document share one name scope.
rules.fix: Rename one of the elements or convert the pages per file.

rules.title: CSS rule that no page matches
rules.why: The rule is dead weight in the shared stylesheet.
rules.fix: Remove the rule or list its class in naming.dynamicClasses.

rules.title: Missing partial or include target
rules.why: The include or template reference cannot be resolved.
rules.fix: Fix the path or the id.

rules.title: Include cycle
rules.why: A partial includes itself directly or through other partials.
rules.fix: Break the cycle.

rules.title: Navigation or modal target not found in the input set
rules.why: data-nav and data-modal must point to a page or modal that exists in the assembled inputs.
rules.fix: Fix the target id or add the page.

rules.title: Two inputs map to the same output path
rules.why: One file would overwrite the other.
rules.fix: Rename one page (meta uitk:screen) or set a per-file name in the job.

rules.title: Input pattern matched nothing
rules.why: The glob or folder in the job has no files.
rules.fix: Fix the pattern.

rules.title: Inlined partial renamed repeated elements
rules.why: Names must stay unique when a partial is inlined more than once.
rules.fix: Use templates (ui:Instance) to keep one name scope per instance.

rules.title: Output name collision resolved with a suffix
rules.why: Two inputs derive the same screen name.
rules.fix: Set meta uitk:screen or a per-file name in the job.

rules.title: Visible text without a localisation key
rules.why: Project rule: the UI contains no raw text, only keys resolved through the string table.
rules.fix: Add data-loc="<key>" (the text between the tags stays as the mock text).

rules.title: Localisation key has an invalid format
rules.why: Keys must match the key pattern of the project (see config localization.keyPattern).
rules.fix: Use dotted lower-case identifiers, for example menu.main.play.

rules.title: New localisation key
rules.why: The key is not in the string table; it is listed in the generated keys stub.
rules.fix: Add the key to the table (merge the stub) before shipping.

rules.title: Mock text differs from the string table
rules.why: The mock should show the real text so the design review sees the real lengths.
rules.fix: Copy the text from the table (or update the table).

rules.title: Same key with different mock texts
rules.why: One key resolves to one text at runtime; the mock shows two.
rules.fix: Use one text or two keys.

rules.title: data-loc on an element without a text property
rules.why: The mapped UI Toolkit element has no text, label or title attribute.
rules.fix: Move data-loc to a span inside, or map the element to a control with text.

rules.title: Control with data-loc but no data-text
rules.why: Inputs cannot hold text in HTML, so the mock label needs data-text to show the real length.
rules.fix: Add data-text="<mock text>".

rules.title: Duplicate element name
rules.why: Names are used by code lookups (Q<T>("name")); duplicates make lookups ambiguous.
rules.fix: Rename one of the elements.

rules.title: Element name is not kebab-case
rules.why: Project naming convention: lower-case kebab-case names.
rules.fix: Rename to lower-case words separated by '-'.

rules.title: Interactive element without a name
rules.why: Code cannot look up an element without a name.
rules.fix: Add name="...".

rules.title: Class name does not match the naming pattern
rules.why: Class names must match the project pattern (kebab-case with optional BEM __ and -- parts).
rules.fix: Rename the class.

rules.title: Name or class without an allowed prefix
rules.why: Project convention: names and classes carry the prefix of their screen or component family.
rules.fix: Add one of the configured prefixes.

rules.title: id and name disagree
rules.why: HTML id and name both map to the UXML name; they must be identical.
rules.fix: Keep only name.

rules.title: Class has no style rule
rules.why: A class used in the markup is defined neither in the page CSS nor in a referenced skin stylesheet nor listed as a code-toggled class.
rules.fix: Add a rule, remove the class, or list it in usage.dynamicClasses.

rules.title: No start page
rules.why: A flow with pages needs exactly one data-start page.
rules.fix: Add data-start to one page.

rules.title: More than one start page
rules.why: The router needs a single start page.
rules.fix: Keep data-start on one page.

rules.title: Navigation target does not exist
rules.why: data-nav points to a page id that is not defined.
rules.fix: Fix the id or add the page.

rules.title: Orphan page
rules.why: No data-nav, data-modal or data-back leads to or from the page and it is not the start page.
rules.fix: Link the page or remove it.

rules.title: Unreachable page
rules.why: No path from the start page reaches this page.
rules.fix: Add a navigation edge.

rules.title: Back from the start page
rules.why: data-back on the start page has nothing to return to.
rules.fix: Remove it or define the quit behaviour in code.

rules.title: Duplicate modal id
rules.why: Modal ids must be unique in the flow.
rules.fix: Rename one modal.

rules.title: Inconsistent tab group
rules.why: Every data-tab needs a panel in the same group and the group needs a default.
rules.fix: Fix data-tabs, data-tab and the panel names.

rules.title: Unknown page transition
rules.why: data-transition must be fade, slide-left, slide-right, slide-up, scale or none.
rules.fix: Use one of the known transitions.

rules.title: No focusable element on a page
rules.why: Keyboard and gamepad navigation needs a focusable element on every page.
rules.fix: Add a button or mark a focus target.

rules.title: Navigation requires a runtime component
rules.why: Pages, modals and tabs are switched by the router component of the runtime package (or the NeoxiderUiKit adapter), not by USS.
rules.fix: Add the router component to the scene and load the generated nav.json.

rules.title: Font size below the project minimum
rules.why: Small text is unreadable on a 1080p reference and on phones.
rules.fix: Raise font-size to the configured minimum.

rules.title: Touch target below the project minimum
rules.why: Interactive elements smaller than the minimum are hard to hit with a finger or a gamepad cursor.
rules.fix: Raise min-height/min-width or the padding of the interactive element.

rules.title: nowrap text without ellipsis clipping
rules.why: A single-line label wider than its box overflows visibly and overlaps its neighbours.
rules.fix: Add overflow: hidden and text-overflow: ellipsis (and a width or flex-shrink).

rules.title: Colour literal outside the token block
rules.why: The project style rules require colours to come from tokens (var(--...)).
rules.fix: Move the colour into a :root token and reference it with var().

rules.title: Transition on a property that does not animate
rules.why: Discrete and non-animatable properties switch in one step; the transition has no effect.
rules.fix: Transition opacity, colours, translate, scale or rotate instead.

rules.title: Unsupported easing function
rules.why: USS transition-timing-function accepts the keyword list of Unity only (ease, ease-in, ease-out, ease-in-out, linear and the extended ease-* names); no cubic-bezier() or steps().
rules.fix: Use a keyword; ease-out-cubic is close to cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1).

rules.title: Transition on a layout property
rules.why: Animating width, height, margin, padding or position recalculates the layout every frame and can drop the frame rate.
rules.fix: Animate translate, scale, rotate or opacity instead.

rules.title: Invalid transition declaration
rules.why: The transition list is malformed (wrong time unit, empty list or too many values).
rules.fix: Write transition: <property> <duration> [<easing>] [<delay>].

rules.title: text-align mapped to -unity-text-align
rules.why: USS has a 9-position -unity-text-align instead of CSS text-align; vertical alignment was assumed to be middle.
rules.fix: Write -unity-text-align explicitly (for example middle-center) next to text-align.

rules.title: UXML syntax error
rules.why: The UXML document is not well-formed XML.
rules.fix: Fix the markup at the reported position.

rules.title: Text is wider or taller than its box (browser design-time check)
rules.why: In UI Toolkit overflowing text paints over its neighbours or is clipped, so the overlap seen in the browser also appears in Unity.
rules.fix: Widen the box, allow wrapping, or add overflow: hidden with text-overflow: ellipsis.

rules.title: Siblings overlap (browser design-time check)
rules.why: Two in-flow siblings occupy the same area; the converted screen overlaps the same way.
rules.fix: Fix margins, widths or flex-shrink so the siblings do not overlap.
